title: Canonical AIAS CAD/BIM Integration
purpose: Bridge stable BIM elements into the Enterprise Drawing Framework with explicit units, mappings and semantic-loss evidence.
scope: Neutral interchange model, footprint projection, element-to-entity maps, loss reporting, JSON integrity, allowlisted property synchronization and Lighthouse consumer.

requirements.title: Neutral contract
requirements.statement: Interchange models shall use stable BIM identity, versions, millimetres and source provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Drawing projection
requirements.statement: Supported BIM footprints shall map deterministically to canonical drawing entities.
requirements.rationale: Connect BIM semantics to portable drawings.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Loss disclosure
requirements.statement: Every unsupported semantic element shall appear in an explicit loss report.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Controlled synchronization
requirements.statement: Property updates shall be allowlisted, non-mutating and require transaction commit and professional review.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: The Lighthouse BIM reference shall produce JSON, SVG, DXF and PDF drawings without undisclosed losses.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: CAD/BIM integration shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
